## Activity

During October 2023, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 385 captures. This activity represents the total number of image captures recorded for the reporting period. The figure provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the site. Activity is reported for the clinic and month specified, with the results considered together across the operational measures below.

## Image quality

Of the 385 captures, 21 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.5 per cent. These results indicate the number and proportion of captures that could not be used for grading. Image quality is reported separately from the grading outcome so that the extent of incomplete assessment remains clear.

## Grading

Grading identified 103 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This measure describes the central grading turnaround for the reporting period, while the referable total records the number of results requiring referral. Together, these figures summarise the grading workload and the timeliness of the grading process at West Gate Eye Clinic during October 2023.
